7	- `bun src/cli.ts --help` prints a usage line that lists `--shout`, for example `usage: greet [name] [--shout]`.

11	1. Add an optional `shout` option to `greet()` that upper-cases the whole greeting, defaulting to off so current callers are unaffected. Add unit tests for `greet('Ada', { shout: true })` returning `HELLO, ADA!`, for the blank-name case returning `HELLO, WORLD!`, and for the default staying `Hello, Ada!`. Files: `src/greet.ts`, `test/greet.test.ts`.
12	2. Make the CLI recognise `--shout` anywhere in the arguments, take the first remaining argument that isn't a flag as the name, and pass `shout` through to `greet()`. 13	3. Change the `--help` usage text to list `--shout` (`usage: greet [name] [--shout]`) and update the existing help test to match. Files: `src/cli.ts`, `test/cli.test.ts`.
